ensemble.weight: decay ** source_age_ticks; normalize over available causal history
ensemble.gripper_projection: each selected source gripper normalized to [0,1] before averaging; preserve raw and delta

existing_arm_role: explicit language-selected active side; inactive arm ready-command hold, not learned autonomous selection
effect: documents next-run baseline; no process hot-patched or launched
limits: old development cases, not independent test performance; smoothing does not establish grasp or tactile causal benefit
